body: I found out why stackblitz and my app throw differrent errors. My app is served with a base href and stackblitz isn't. If you inspect the link in the stackblitz reproduction after step 2, the href is "//(lazy)".

rename.from: relative routing over lazy route boundaries causes weird urls and breaks the routing eventually
rename.to: relative routing to a route with empty path causes weird urls and breaks the routing eventually

body: I found out that it hasn't anything to do with lazy loading, so I updated the issue text above. The problem seems to be a relative navigation to a route with empty path.
Issue is still present in Angular 9.1.0: https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-lazy-route-relative-bug-fjhdin?file=src%2Fapp%2Fapp.module.ts

also related: #13011

Also note that `{relativeLinkResolution: 'corrected'}` does not resolve this issue.
